description: Send a transactional or marketing email to one or more recipients.

to.description: List of recipients; minimum 1 entry. Each entry has email (required) and name (optional).

reply_to.description: Optional reply-to email address; must be a valid email

template_id.description: Optional template ID; if provided, body is ignored

body.description: Email body content; required when template_id is not provided

cc.description: Optional list of CC email addresses

priority.description: Send priority: low, normal, or high

sample_payload.subject: Your weekly summary
sample_payload.body: Here is your activity for this week.
